title: Special Executive Programme In Business Research Methods
description: The Special Executive Program in Business Research Methods aims to enable the learner to conduct effective business research by understanding the fundamentals of information search, Analysis and critique skills, data collection methods and professional business report drafting.
longDescription: The Special Executive Program in Business Research Methods aims to enable the learner to conduct effective business research by understanding the fundamentals of information search, Analysis and critique skills, data collection methods and professional business report drafting. The course aims to introduce the learner to the business research process by enabling the learner to gain skills such as choosing a topic, crafting a research question, reviewing literature, citations and references. The learner will be able to produce professional business research reports after learning different research philosophies, research methods and data analysis techniques.
courseDetails: The Special Executive Program in Business Research Methods is designed to empower learners with the advanced skills necessary for conducting impactful business research. This program provides a comprehensive foundation in the principles and practices of business research, including information search, analysis, critique, data collection, and professional report drafting.
